description: Register a ZuoraResource wrapping the Zuora REST API. OAuth2 client-credentials flow -- Zuora deprecated session-based Z-Session auth for all tenants on 2024-08-01, so OAuth2 is the only supported mechanism now. Exposes a generic request() plus query() (ZOQL via POST /v1/action/query, used for lookup-before-write since the generic Object CRUD API has no filter-by-field GET).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Zuora REST endpoint (region/environment-specific, e.g. rest.na.zuora.com, rest.eu.zuora.com, or a sandbox host).

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var with the Zuora OAuth2 Client ID.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var with the Zuora OAuth2 Client Secret.

name: Zuora Resource
